quizName:
Hardest Questions in Missouri
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: If you drive while intoxicated and injure or kill someone, what can happen?

options.text: You will only have to pay a fine.
You will only go to jail.
You will only lose your license.
You may lose your license and go to jail.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose your license and go to jail.
questions.explanation: Driving while intoxicated is illegal and dangerous. If you cause an accident that injures or kills someone, you may go to jail for two to seven years, pay a $5,000 fine, and lose your license for five years.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: When stopped, you must show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You must carry all three documents in your vehicle when driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. They control traffic speed and movement. This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: When should you slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where pedestrians are present, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: You are angry after a work incident. When you get in your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the interstate to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, calm down before driving. Driving while angry is dangerous to you and others on the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, harms your coordination and balance, and damages your vision and ability to judge distance.

questions.question: You miss your turn or exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Make a quick turn from your lane.
Keep driving until you find the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you find the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your turn or exit, do not back up. Instead, drive to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around. Backing up on a freeway or shoulder is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what rules they must follow. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make many decisions every mile they drive. It is important to focus fully on driving. Any other activity can create a dangerous distraction.

questions.question: Where must you keep proof of your liability insurance?

options.text: In a safety deposit box at the bank.

questions.explanation: State law requires all drivers to have liability insurance. You must carry proof of insurance in your vehicle. If a police officer asks for proof and you cannot show it, you will get a ticket.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: Anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel is a distraction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what rules they must follow. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Cars turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings ahead. This sign tells drivers to watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other traffic is visible.
Signal only if other traffic is visible.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other traffic is visible.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from the curb. Make it a habit to always signal, not just sometimes.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, what should you do?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Ignore how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. A train or other vehicle may be using the tracks.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means:

options.text: The light is about to turn red.
The car ahead is going too slow.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light is about to turn red.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means the light is changing from green to red. Slow down and stop. Only continue if you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely.

questions.question: Driving ability can be affected by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good physical condition. Alcohol, legal and illegal drugs, and tiredness can all affect driving ability.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.
